requirement: Generate a one-axis robot joint named EvaluationJoint with inertia 0.6 kg.m2 and damping 0.15 N.m.s/rad. Apply 1.2 N.m from rest. Expose angle and angularVelocity and simulate for 2 seconds.
Generate a PD-controlled rotary joint named EvaluationServo that moves from zero to 0.75 rad. Expose angle and ensure it settles within 0.05 rad of target from 4 to 5 seconds.

Generate a voltage-driven DC motor joint named EvaluationMotor including current, back EMF, torque production, inertia, and damping. Expose current, angularVelocity, and angle; angle must become positive within 2 seconds.

Generate a sampled position controller named EvaluationDigitalJoint with a 0.1 second sample period, held torque command, joint angle and angularVelocity states, and a 1.2 rad target. Angle must remain below 1.5 rad for 6 seconds.
Generate a differential-drive kinematic model named EvaluationRover with x, y, and heading states. Use unequal constant wheel speeds so heading exceeds 0.5 rad within 4 seconds.

Generate a flexible actuator named EvaluationFlexibleJoint with separate motorAngle and jointAngle states, motor and load inertias, and a spring-damper transmission. Under positive motor torque, jointAngle must become positive within 3 seconds.
Generate a filtered joint-angle sensor named EvaluationAngleSensor with trueAngle, measuredAngle, and error outputs. The final absolute error after 5 seconds must be below 0.1 rad.
Generate a hydraulic robot cylinder named EvaluationHydraulicAxis with pressure, flowRate, position, and velocity. Positive supply flow must move the piston beyond 0.02 m within 4 seconds.
Generate a smooth cubic joint trajectory named EvaluationTrajectory from zero to one radian over 4 seconds, exposing reference, position, velocity, and trackingError.

Generate two-link planar-arm forward kinematics named EvaluationPlanarArm with joint angles q1 and q2, link lengths, end-effector x and y, and workspace radius no greater than the sum of link lengths.
